experiences.whyGo: A flexible Quiet Corner stop with a free 18-hole disc golf course, lake views, a four-mile shoreline trail, shorter woodland trails, and a five-mile Quinebaug River Water Trail for experienced paddlers.
experiences.tryThis: Play at least nine disc-golf holes or walk a shoreline section, then stop at the dam overlook.
experiences.notes: The campground is not accepting 2026 reservations because of maintenance repairs, but the recreation page continues to list trails, disc golf and the boat ramp. Fall hunting occurs in parts of the property; the Army Corps recommends fluorescent orange during hunting season.

experiences.name: White Memorial Conservation Center
experiences.notes: Museum hours are Tuesday through Saturday 9 AM to 5 PM and Sunday noon to 5 PM. Adult museum admission is $6. Current site notice says some wetland-adjacent trails may be flooded after heavy rain, so check conditions before going.

experiences.name: Wickham Park Gardens
experiences.notes: Open seven days a week from the first weekend in April through the last weekend in October, generally 9:30 AM to sunset. The park may close for inclement weather.

experiences.name: Wilton Historical Society America 250 + Wilton 300
experiences.notes: The Society states that general museum admission is free through 2026. Special events may have separate fees.

experiences.name: Winding Trails Cross Country Ski Center
Windsor Meadows Bissell Bridge River Walk
experiences.notes: The Windsor River Trail is ADA accessible. Pets are allowed on leash.

experiences.name: Woodbury Brewing Company
experiences.notes: Best brewery pick for people who want live entertainment as part of the visit.

experiences.name: Woodcock Nature Center Free Trail & Raptor Visit
experiences.notes: Current fall listings include a free adult walk on September 17 and Under the Harvest Moon on September 26. Event registration and pricing vary.
